None is documented here, so the ischemic-heart-disease point is unsupported. Congestive heart failure contributes 1 point. Shoulder arthroscopy is not high-risk surgery under RCRI, creatinine 1.7 mg/dL is below the >2 mg/dL threshold, and cerebrovascular disease and insulin treatment are absent. The pretreatment total is therefore 1, outside the accepted range.
